text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said Friday it raised its fiscal 1998 earnings estimate for Lattice Semiconductor Corp to $2.60 a share from $2.50 and introduced an estimate for fiscal 1999 of $3.25.

-- Lattice reported fourth-quarter 1996 earnings in line with Gruntal's $0.55 a share estimate and the company continues to gain higher revenues and orders from its high density CPLD product line, Gruntal said.
-- Additionally, Lattice's margins continue to expand and top line growth should top 25 percent for the coming fiscal year, Gruntal said.
-- Lattice designs and manufactures high-performance integrated circuits.
-- Its shares closed up 2-3/8 Friday at 50-1/4.
